description: Recent US recalls matching a keyword: CPSC consumer-product recalls (saferproducts.gov, by recall date and description text) and FDA food enforcement reports (openFDA, reason for recall). Vehicle (NHTSA) and FDA drug/device recalls are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

days.description: CPSC look-back window in days, 1 to 365 (default 60)

q.description: Keyword, 3 to 60 characters, e.g. laminator, listeria
